citation: Nebenfuehr et al. 2026, Cell Reports (combinatorial CRISPR map of the DNA-repair network, eHAP iCas9)
license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article); GEO GSE290153 data public
label_rule: none (not labelled; excluded before labelling because the basal arm does not replicate and shows no single-gene fitness signal)

design.note: library symbols use mouse-style case (e.g. Abl1, Trp53, 4930447C04Rik) but the guides are human: all 4 BRCA1 and all 4 PCNA guides match the human genomic sequence (Ensembl REST) and none match mouse; 453/459 symbols resolve to HGNC after upper-casing

count_quality.note: rep3 is not among the GEO samples (only 2 control reps deposited as GSMs) and its day0 has ~8M reads with 42% zeros; day14_rep1 is bottlenecked (54% zeros)

own_replication.method: spidr_replicate_gi recipe per replicate (LFC day14 vs same-rep day0, centred on nt x nt, f_g = median gene x nt, GI = LFC - f_a - f_b, median over guide pairs)

common_day0_variant.note: using pooled day0 rep1+rep2 as a common reference; the rep1-rep3 0.235 comes from the shared day0 term, not shared biology

fitness_sanity.note: core-essential DNA-replication genes are not depleted at day 14 in any replicate, so the basal counts carry no detectable fitness signal

cross_study.note: not run: no other SLB measurement in eHAP; HAP1 (chymera2020, billmann2026) is related but without a replicable signal here labels could not be defined

verdict_reason: Basal-arm replicates do not agree (guide-pair LFC Spearman -0.03 to 0.03, pair-GI Spearman -0.01, split-rule AUROC 0.40-0.62, all < 0.65), and essential genes show no depletion in any replicate (single-effect vs DepMap Spearman -0.09 to 0.06), consistent with day-14 bottlenecking (54% zero counts in day14_rep1) and a failed rep3 day0 (8M reads, 42% zeros). No labels can be defined; no cross-study partner in eHAP. Not staged, not even measurements-only, since the scores are noise.
